description: This Java class 'ResponseHelper' provides utility methods for constructing and sending WebDAV HTTP responses, including creating XML elements for multistatus responses, setting response headers, and writing XML documents to the response.

classes.name: ResponseHelper
classes.description: Helper class for constructing and sending WebDAV responses, managing XML document creation and response formatting.

methods.name: prepareResponse
methods.description: Sets content type, character encoding, and status/error for the HTTP response.

methods.name: createElementSetValue
methods.description: Creates an XML element with a specified name and text value within the response document.

methods.name: createHrefElement
methods.description: Creates an XML 'href' element with a given URL.

methods.name: createMultiStatusElement
methods.description: Creates a 'multistatus' XML element for WebDAV responses.

methods.name: createResponseDescriptionElement
methods.description: Creates a 'responsedescription' XML element with optional language attribute.

methods.name: createStatusElement
methods.description: Creates a 'status' XML element with specified status text.

methods.name: getResponseDocument
methods.description: Returns the XML Document object representing the response.

methods.name: writeResponse
methods.description: Serializes the XML document and writes it to the HTTP response output.
